system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: a relevant experience snippet exp g∈EXP(g) is first retrieved (see Section 4.1) and injected into the initial prompt following a predefined template, e.g., {system prompt}<EXP>{exp g}</EXP>{query}
system_prompt_style.note: Context Manager composes prompts from templates; experience injection makes it arguably dynamically_composed when self-navigating is on.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: At each step of exploration, the LLM observes the environment, thinks for the goals and options, and outputs an action to interact with the environment.
env_context_strategy.note: Environment profiles also injected up front; arguably mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: When its size exceeds a predefined threshold, the Context Manager summarizes older content into a compressed memory message and initializes a new timeline window
context_compaction.note: Sliding context window and self-context managing templates; basic causal template (default) does no compaction.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: This separation allows the same rollout infrastructure to host diverse agent workflows—such as ReAct policies, planner–executor schemes, or tool-using agents—without modification to the service layer.
loop_primitives.note: planner-executor reachable by modifying the context manager (code change), so not listed.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: structured prompts encourage the model to generate <think> tokens before decisions, with additional rewards promoting high-quality reasoning

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each worker interacts with the environment to initialize instances, execute actions, and collect observations, and with the model to assemble prompts and invoke the LLM in sequence, generating a complete trajectory for a given task.
multi_agent_topology.note: Game Arena extension hosts multi-agent social games (peer), but the default training harness runs a single rollout agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each worker interacts with the environment to initialize instances, execute actions, and collect observations, and with the model to assemble prompts and invoke the LLM in sequence, generating a complete trajectory for a given task.
delegation_mechanism.note: No delegation mechanism described in the rollout stack.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Rollout Manager / Master (top): Oversees scheduling of multiple rollout workers, defines termination criteria, and coordinates curriculum strategies across workers.
human_in_loop.note: No approval/confirmation gate in the training loop; the Game Arena web UI allows a human to participate as a player, not to gate agent actions.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Live Context Timeline (LCT)— a mutable sequence representing the agent’s current working context during multi-turn interaction.
short_term_state.note: Plus an immutable TSR snapshot buffer used for training, not for agent state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: vector store updating, where validated task experiences are indexed and integrated into the long-term experience storage for subsequent retrieval and reasoning
long_term_memory.note: Experience pool is an embedding-indexed store of distilled natural-language experiences reused across runs; closest values are episodic_db/skill_library/vector_store — coded episodic_db as experiences are distilled from past trajectories.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we offer an LLM-based judge as a fallback proxy for Freward, providing general-purpose assessment across diverse environments
self_verification.note: Also LLM-based step attribution (GOOD/BAD) and experience validation by an LLM evaluator.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Rollout Manager / Master (top): Oversees scheduling of multiple rollout workers, defines termination criteria, and coordinates curriculum strategies across workers.
termination_condition.note: Termination criteria defined by the manager; specific conditions not enumerated in available evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Service Layer (bottom):Comprising theEnvironment ServerandLLM Server, this layer manages multiple independent environment or model workers.
execution_isolation.note: Actions execute in environment workers behind a separate environment service (e.g., AppWorld env-service launched via `--with-appworld`), not in the agent process.

tracing.evidence_quote: Structured logs: all companion logs live under `logs/companion/` with a file name pattern `<tag>.<hash>.<hostname>.log`
tracing.note: A rollout log viewer (`--with-logview`) exists; per-step trajectory records are used for training but no trace format is documented in the available evidence.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `bash examples/run_basic.sh` - Execute basic RL pipeline with GRPO using built-in datasets within environments.
eval_hooks.note: AppWorld and BFCL-v3 benchmark environments ship as env_service environments with setup scripts and built-in datasets.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have the poten- tial to significantly enhance human productivity by reasoning, using tools, and executing complex tasks in diverse environments.
target_domain.note: Shipped environments: AppWorld, BFCL-v3, WebShop, Crafters, plus social-game arena (other = RL training framework / games).

open_source.note: Apache-2.0 per README badge; LICENSE file not opened.

model_agnostic.note: OpenAI-compatible api_key/base_url/model_name configuration; policy model is a locally trained open-weight LLM (Qwen2.5).
